claim_ceiling: TF-IDF production default (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5) validated at 174k scale (LangDom=0.4773, JP=0.7345). Dense embeddings recover citation heritage at scale (AUC 0.79-0.85) exceeding TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.71-0.74) but FAIL jurist gate at all scales (JP 0.05-0.40). Linear hybrids PASS adversarial at 19yr (JP~0.54) but below TF-IDF baseline. No further same-cycle progress possible without external data dependencies.
evidence_summary: Verified all 11 critical findings against source evidence: (1) TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 8/8 PASS adversarial, best JP=0.7345. (2) Dense blocker fundamental: 144k/174k decisions, missing 2022-2026, no parquet, no bge_/bger_ mapping. (3) center_projected FAILS jurist gate at ALL scales: 3yr JP=0.39-0.42, 15yr JP=0.288, 19yr JP=0.3685, 20yr JP=0.0475 (catastrophic), 22yr JP=0.3975. (4) Linear combos PASS at 19yr (JP=0.5395-0.5445) but below TF-IDF baseline (JP=0.7235); 15yr FAIL (JP=0.473). (5) Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt superior (gap 0.187 vs 0.452). (6) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced: Citation JP~0.73 vs Semantic JP~0.05-0.40 vs Hybrid JP~0.54. (7) v8 holdout validates minimal leakage (ΔJP -0.009 to -0.034). (8) Dense citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF citation 0.71-0.74 > TF-IDF text 0.50-0.63. (9) Boilerplate resistance negative all reps (-0.74 to -0.93). (10) v18 hierarchy negative (purity<0.7). (11) v17b regime-dependent at scale. All claims supported by reproducible evidence. No gaming, leakage, or overclaiming detected.
